name: Screenshot the Nox editor next to the C++ one
body: Both editors under Xvfb at 1680x1000 with `left_wall` selected: `docs/editor-nox-screenshot.png` (Nox host) and `docs/editor-cpp-screenshot.png` (C++ host). They match: menus, toolbar, outliner with lock icons, the level view, inspector, asset thumbnails with captions and the preview.
